_meta.notes: Breaking Ground not installed: empty state. `robotics.available` is deliberately ABSENT rather than false. Without the expansion the Uplink goes Unavailable and never emits on that channel at all, so a fixture setting it false encoded the confusion the widget used to have: it read `available === false` as 'the DLC is missing' when that value actually means 'this craft carries no robotic part'. The DLC fact comes off `game.dlc.breakingGround`, which is ground-side and independent of any vessel.

_scene.caption: Breaking Ground not installed: the console names the missing DLC rather than reporting a craft with no joints on it
_scene.expectsEmpty: There are no robotic parts without the DLC. The subject of the scene is the sentence the console shows in their place, which must not read as 'this craft has no servos'.
